ModMetaData.name: Storage Group Quotas
ModMetaData.author: Steel-Shadow
ModMetaData.description:
Set per-item limits for an entire vanilla storage group. Linked shelves share one quota.
The quota window uses a category tree. Unset items and child categories inherit the nearest configured parent, while exceptional items can keep their own values. In Similar stacks mode, per-stack limits and maximum stack counts inherit independently. Category values apply separately to each descendant item rather than forming one shared quantity or stack pool. The list refreshes with vanilla storage-filter changes and shares vanilla category folding.
Use Entire storage count when only the total matters, or Similar stacks ×N to keep several physical stacks as separate reservation targets for ammo and urgent supplies. X and N can be configured independently by category or item. Incoming hauling respects the remaining quota. Existing excess is moved outside the group through hauling work, never deleted.
Requires Harmony. Hauler's Dream and Pick Up And Haul are optional: when either is active, nearby total-count overflow from one source group can be collected into pawn inventory up to the selected hauling mod's carry limit and unloaded with live quota checks. Hauler's Dream smart overload and CE weight/bulk rules are preserved; vanilla hauling remains the fallback.
Optional compatibility is included for Digital Storage 3.0 and Manipulator Beam Emitter. Digital Storage's direct shelf routes are clamped to the live quota. Ordinary beam stacks reserve both their quota amount and any new stack slot; every actual carried item is checked again on arrival, preventing several beams from repeatedly overfilling the same group. Digital Storage Buffer Warehouses keep their own Min/Max controls and are excluded from SGQ; if linked to other shelves, the whole linked group is excluded. To keep items on a physical shelf, set the Digital Storage core below that shelf's priority.
Incompatible with Stack Gap.
为整个原版存储组设置按物品分别计算的数量上限；链接的物品架共享同一份配额。
配额窗口使用分类树。未设置的物品和子分类会继承最近的已设置父级，少数例外物品仍可保留单独设置。在“类似堆栈 ×N”模式中，每堆上限和最大堆数分别独立继承。分类值由每种后代物品分别使用，并不是整个分类共用的数量或堆位预算。列表会随原版存储筛选实时刷新，并共享原版分类折叠状态。
只关心总量时使用“整个仓库数量”；需要为弹药或紧急补给保留多个独立预留目标时，使用“类似堆栈 ×N”。X 和 N 都可以按分类或物品分别设置。新的入库搬运会遵守剩余配额，已有超量物品会通过搬运工作移出该组，不会被删除。
需要 Harmony。Hauler's Dream 与 Pick Up And Haul 均为可选适配；启用其中之一时，小人可把同一来源存储组中附近的总量超额物品按所选搬运模组的负重规则批量装入库存，并在卸货时重新核对实时配额。Hauler's Dream 的智能超载及 CE 重量／体积规则会被保留；无法使用兼容路径时仍回退原版搬运。
可选兼容【CA】数字存储-Digital Storage 3.0 与 Manipulator Beam Emitter（牵引光束）。数字存储直接送往物品架的物品会按实时配额裁剪；普通物品的光束传送会同时预留数量和新堆位，所有实际搬运物都会在到达时再次核对，避免多道光束反复塞满同一存储组。数字存储的缓冲仓库继续使用自身 Min/Max，不由本模组管理；如果它链接到其他物品架，整个链接组都不显示或执行 SGQ 配额。希望实体物品架保留库存时，请把数字存储核心的优先级设得低于该物品架。
与 Stack Gap 不兼容。
